result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: restaurant names are truncated in the horizontal carousel, and the bottom navigation is missing its Orders icon.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the 'Fastest near you' row are cut off mid-word (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol'), making them hard to read even though the cards themselves are partially visible as intended.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure card width and text truncation (ellipsis) so names remain fully legible.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar shows labels for Home, Search, Orders, and Profile, but the Orders tab has no icon above its label while the others do.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon so all four tabs are visually consistent.
